France completes test of new nuclear-capable missile
subhed: France's armed forces test-fired a new M51.3 nuclear-capable ballistic missile in the Atlantic Ocean on Tuesday, the defense ministry said. President Emmanuel Macron said the test 'demonstrates the credibility' of France's nuclear deterrent.

title: Despite pain, two former October 7 Hamas hostages promote message of peace
subhed: Among the 251 Israelis taken captive by Hamas on October 7, 2023, Aviva and Keith Siegel chose to speak publicly about the abuse they suffered. While Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has claimed the release of hostages as an achievement in his election campaign, the couple in their 60s has continued to oppose the war.

title: Cheikh Hamidou Kane, voice of Senegalese history, has died
subhed: A writer, statesman and minister several times over, Cheikh Hamidou Kane was both a major witness to and a participant in Senegal's contemporary history. He died in Dakar on October 3, at 98 years old.

title: On Cornell's campus, 'everyone is outraged' by the handling of gang rape case
subhed: While she was still a student, a young woman claimed that she was drugged and raped by seven members of a fraternity at the Ivy League university. Many students feel that the alleged perpetrators were not punished severely enough. In September, the plaintiff took her case to the New York State Supreme Court.

subhed: The French health authorities reported that 8,124 deaths were related to the extreme heatwaves between late May and late August in France. Le Monde spoke to the friends and families of 11 of the victims to find out about the lives behind those numbers.
